sayings.text: Whoever puts their feet on Shirdi soil, their sufferings will come to an end.
The wretched and miserable will rise to joy and happiness as soon as they climb the steps of the Samadhi Mandir.
I shall be ever active and vigorous even after leaving this earthly body.
My tomb shall bless and speak to the needs of my devotees.
I shall be active and vigorous even from the tomb.
My mortal remains will speak from my tomb.
I am ever living to help and guide all who come to me, who surrender to me and who seek refuge in me.
If you look to me, I look to you.
If you cast your burden on me, I shall surely bear it.
If you seek my advice and help, it shall be given to you at once.
There shall be no want in the house of my devotee.

aartis.name: Kakad Aarti
aartis.subtitle: The Morning Awakening Prayer
aartis.meaning: Devotees gather before sunrise to gently wake Baba with sweet, loving hymns and prayers for spiritual awakening.
verses: Joduniyaa kara charanee thevila maatha | Parisawe vinantee maazhee Sadguru naatha ||
Aso nasso bhaava aalo tujhiyaa thhaayaa | Kripaa drishtee paahay maazhyaa Sadguru raayaa ||
Uthaa Panduranga aataa prabhaat samayo paatalaa | Vaishnavaancha mela garudapaaree daatalaa ||
Uthaa uthaa Shree Saainaathha Guru charana kamala daavaa | Aadhivyaadhi bhawataapa vaaruni taaraa jada jeeva ||

aartis.name: Madhyan Aarti
aartis.subtitle: The Afternoon Offering
aartis.meaning: Midday prayer and offering of Naivedya (food) honoring Sai Baba as the supreme divine host.
verses: Gheuniyaa panchaarati karoo Babansi aarati | Karoo Saayeesi aarati ||
Uthha uthha baa Saayeerama aataa aalelya paahunaa | Bhakteechiya premabhaave baadhilee shidori ||
Aarati Saayee Baba, saukhyadaataara jeeva | Charana rajataalee, dhyawaa daasaam visaawaa ||

aartis.name: Dhoop Aarti
aartis.subtitle: The Evening Twilight Prayer
aartis.meaning: At sunset, as lamps are lit at the Dhuni and Dwarkamai, devotees sing praises thanking Baba for His shelter through the day.
verses: Aarati Saayee Baba, saukhyadaataara jeeva | Charana rajataalee, dhyawaa daasaam visaawaa ||
Jaya deva jaya deva Datta avadhootaa | Owaaloo aarati Maazhyaa Sadguru Saayeeshaa ||
Kaarunyasindhu Baba dinaancha daataa | Maazhi he vinantee aayikee Eeshwara raayaa ||

aartis.name: Shej Aarti
aartis.subtitle: The Night Rest Prayer
aartis.meaning: The final aarti of the day, a soothing lullaby bidding Sai Baba peaceful rest and seeking His protection through the night.
verses: Owaaloo aarati maazhyaa Sadguru raayaa | Shreemanta Saayeenaathha charana kamalaa ||
Aataa suvaamee sukhe nidra karaa avadhootaa | Chinmaya he roopa maazhe daakhawaa netraam ||
Paava ga Saayeeraayaa bhava sagara taaree | Kripaakatakshe maazhyaa hridayaantee raahoo ||
